component.name: SmartClock Monitor
component.summary: Monitor a GPS-disciplined oscillator over RS-232

description.p: SmartClock Monitor watches and controls HP/Symmetricom SmartClock GPS-disciplined oscillators — the Z3805A and its siblings, the Z3801A, 58503A/B, 59551A and Z3816A — over a serial port. These units are widely used in home and small laboratories as a 10 MHz frequency and 1 PPS time reference.

One window answers the two questions a glance is asking: what state the receiver is in, and how well it is behaving. A details window carries the satellites, position, timing, status registers, diagnostics and holdover, with the trend history kept across restarts.
Commands the receiver accepts that can render it unusable are not offered, not listed and not reachable: the command set is an allowlist rather than a filtered catalogue.
It runs without a receiver attached, replaying captured status screens, so it can be tried before it is trusted.
First release. The port is complete through phase 8 of its plan and has been verified against a live Z3805A.
